symbols.name: coefficient index
symbols.meaning: The position of a coefficient in the list, running from 0 to S minus 1.
symbols.quote: For a coefficient index $\iota$ with $0\le\iota<S$ (the position of a coefficient in the list), $\Phi(x^\iota)=\prod_\alpha x_\alpha^{\mu_\alpha\iota}$ is a monomial whose exponent on $x_\alpha$ is $b_\alpha$, where $0\le b_\alpha<s_\alpha$ and $b_\alpha\equiv\mu_\alpha\iota\pmod{s_\alpha}$.

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: An axis index running from 1 to d, giving the position of an axis.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes, with $\alpha$ and $\beta$ running from $1$ to $d$ as axis indices (not list positions), and let $s_\alpha$ be the length of axis $\alpha$, with $s_1,\ldots,s_d$ pairwise coprime.

symbols.name: second axis index
symbols.meaning: A second axis index running from 1 to d, distinct from the digit width of earlier pages.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes, with $\alpha$ and $\beta$ running from $1$ to $d$ as axis indices (not list positions), and let $s_\alpha$ be the length of axis $\alpha$, with $s_1,\ldots,s_d$ pairwise coprime.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of entries along axis alpha, a positive integer.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes, with $\alpha$ and $\beta$ running from $1$ to $d$ as axis indices (not list positions), and let $s_\alpha$ be the length of axis $\alpha$, with $s_1,\ldots,s_d$ pairwise coprime.

symbols.name: axis variable
symbols.meaning: The formal variable of axis alpha, whose powers index the entries along that axis.
symbols.quote: Let $x_\alpha$ be the variable of axis $\alpha$, and let $\mathcal R=\mathbb C[x_1,\ldots,x_d]/(x_1^{s_1}-1,\ldots,x_d^{s_d}-1)$ be the target ring.

symbols.name: target ring
symbols.meaning: The quotient ring of polynomials in the axis variables that is the target of the axis map.
symbols.quote: Let $x_\alpha$ be the variable of axis $\alpha$, and let $\mathcal R=\mathbb C[x_1,\ldots,x_d]/(x_1^{s_1}-1,\ldots,x_d^{s_d}-1)$ be the target ring.

symbols.name: earlier length product
symbols.meaning: The product of the lengths of the axes before axis alpha.

symbols.name: axis map
symbols.meaning: The algebra map sending x to the product of the axis variables raised to the powers mu_alpha.
symbols.quote: Let $\Phi$ be the algebra map (respecting sums, products and scalars) with $\Phi(x)=\prod_\alpha x_\alpha^{\mu_\alpha}$ that maps $\mathbb C[x]/(x^S-1)$ into the [Quotient ring by several relations](quotient-ring.md) $\mathcal R$.

symbols.name: image exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent on axis alpha of the monomial to which the coefficient at index iota is sent, between 0 and s_alpha minus 1.
symbols.quote: For a coefficient index $\iota$ with $0\le\iota<S$ (the position of a coefficient in the list), $\Phi(x^\iota)=\prod_\alpha x_\alpha^{\mu_\alpha\iota}$ is a monomial whose exponent on $x_\alpha$ is $b_\alpha$, where $0\le b_\alpha<s_\alpha$ and $b_\alpha\equiv\mu_\alpha\iota\pmod{s_\alpha}$.

symbols.name: axis digit
symbols.meaning: The digit of the coefficient index on axis beta, an integer from 0 to s_beta minus 1.
symbols.quote: Each $\iota$ has a unique expansion $\iota=\sum_{\beta=1}^d\delta_\beta P_\beta$ with $0\le\delta_\beta<s_\beta$. Here $\delta_\beta$ is the digit of $\iota$ on axis $\beta$, and $\delta_\alpha$ means the same with $\alpha$ in place of $\beta$.

relations.quote: Because $\Phi$ is an isomorphism, it preserves [Cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md): products of lists map to products of images.
